name: repo-onboarding
description: Orient yourself in an unfamiliar repository in one pass: how to run it, how to test it, where execution starts, and what in the repo is lying to you.

interface.shortDescription: One-pass orientation in an unfamiliar repo
interface.longDescription: Reads what actually executes — Makefile and CI — instead of paraphrasing the README: run/test commands, entry points, the repo's generation rule, and the gotchas that cost an afternoon.
defaultPrompt: How do I run and test this?
